License: COPYING (BSD-3-Clause, Xiph.org Foundation + Adam Gashlin). Data only; the reader is ours (src/audio/wwvorbis.cpp).
The codebooks are the aoTuV beta 6.03 static Vorbis books that Wwise 2011.2+ setup packets reference by 10-bit index.
Layout: codebook data, then a little-endian u32 offset table; the last u32 of the file is the table's offset.
